purpose: Review the first private backend pull request before feature coding begins.

qaLanes.label: Repository shell
qaLanes.check: Root files, workspace, README, env example, CODEOWNERS, PR template, and release runbook exist.

qaLanes.label: API shell
qaLanes.check: Server, app, route registry, health route, request id, safe error, tenant scope, and access decision exist.

qaLanes.label: Package boundaries
qaLanes.check: Shared result, env parser, audit writer, redaction, schema, seeds, fixtures, and importer dry-run exist.

qaLanes.label: Workflow shells
qaLanes.check: CI, security, migration, billing, import, staging, release, and dependency workflows exist with stable names.

qaLanes.label: Backlog taxonomy
qaLanes.check: Labels, milestones, board columns, routing rules, and import steps are ready before the first issue opens.

qaLanes.label: Branch protection timing
qaLanes.check: Protection waits until the first workflow run exposes exact required status check names.

qaLanes.label: Evidence artifacts
qaLanes.check: Install, lint, typecheck, route envelope, auth tenant, redaction, audit, and release-gate proof is expected.

qaLanes.label: Commercial privacy
qaLanes.check: Operational tracker payloads stay free of value, agreement, LOA, invoice, billing, and negotiation data.

fileQaMatrix.check: Starter inventory from the file-content export is present before feature depth.
Explains alpha scope, first proof commands, and commercial privacy rule.
Scripts exist in the export; real dependencies still need first repo install.
Contains placeholder keys only; no live secrets allowed.
Maps platform, API, database, audit, importer, billing, workflows, and docs ownership.
Requires linked issue, proof commands, release notes, affected rooms, and rollback plan.
Request id, safe error, tenant scope, and access decision are present before feature routes.
Audit, redaction, importer, seed, fixture, schema, and shared result boundaries are visible.
Workflow shells map to required proof lanes; exact branch-protection names wait for first CI run.
Merge, staging, rollback, and release ritual are documented before staging depth.

proofCommands.label: Install
proofCommands.proof: Fresh clone can install workspace dependencies.

proofCommands.label: Lint
proofCommands.proof: Code style and obvious syntax drift are caught before review.

proofCommands.label: Typecheck
proofCommands.proof: Type contracts compile before feature depth.

proofCommands.label: Contracts
proofCommands.proof: Endpoint and payload contract shell is visible.

proofCommands.label: Route envelopes
proofCommands.proof: Safe response shape, request id, and error body are expected.

proofCommands.label: Auth tenant
proofCommands.proof: Company scope and role gates are tested early.

proofCommands.label: Commercial redaction
proofCommands.proof: Operational payloads do not leak restricted fields.

proofCommands.label: Audit
proofCommands.proof: Allowed and denied action evidence can be produced.

proofCommands.label: Release gate
proofCommands.proof: Single command summarizes checks, artifacts, blockers, and decision state.

proofCommands.label: Local smoke placeholder
proofCommands.proof: Connects later staging smoke to the first proof chain.

reviewChecklist.label: Repository
reviewChecklist.check: No files committed outside the starter inventory unless named in setup handoff.

reviewChecklist.label: Secrets
reviewChecklist.check: No .env, access token, private key, live billing key, or customer file is committed.

reviewChecklist.label: Issue trace
reviewChecklist.check: First PR links to a generated backend issue.

reviewChecklist.label: Labels
reviewChecklist.check: Issue has type, priority, area, owner, proof, and status labels from the taxonomy pack.

reviewChecklist.label: Milestone
reviewChecklist.check: Issue belongs to M0 or M1 before deeper billing, reports, or import issues start.

reviewChecklist.label: Proof
reviewChecklist.check: PR description includes command output or explains why a placeholder cannot run yet.

reviewChecklist.label: Workflow names
reviewChecklist.check: Branch protection waits for exact GitHub check names after the first run.

reviewChecklist.label: Commercial privacy
reviewChecklist.check: Review confirms tracker shell and API examples do not expose commercial vault fields.

reviewChecklist.label: Rollback
reviewChecklist.check: PR template contains rollback note even for repo-shell initialization.

reviewChecklist.label: Docs
reviewChecklist.check: README and release runbook reflect what actually exists in the first commit.

artifactExpectations.expectation: Result of pnpm install or dependency placeholder note.
Lint output or documented placeholder while dependencies are introduced.
Typecheck output or documented placeholder while TypeScript config is introduced.
Expected safe error and request id proof once route tests exist.
Expected tenant and access decision proof once auth tests exist.
Expected operational payload without commercial fields.
Expected allowed or denied audit event envelope.
Human-readable pass, warn, block, artifact, and owner decision summary.

goNoGoRules.rule: Root files, API shell, package boundaries, workflow shells, labels, milestones, and PR template are present.
No live secrets, customer files, or commercial workbook data are committed.
First PR links to an issue, milestone, labels, proof commands, release note, and rollback note.
Workflow names are unknown; apply branch protection after first CI run only.
package.json scripts reference commands that are not yet implemented; mark proof as placeholder.
Any live secret, customer data, or unrestricted commercial value appears in the commit.
Tenant, access, redaction, or audit boundaries are removed from the starter shell.
Main branch receives direct commits before PR proof and review discipline exist.

roleSignoffs.scope: Repo shell, scripts, workflows, CODEOWNERS, labels, milestones, and PR evidence.
API boot files, route registry, middleware order, and package boundaries.
No secrets, tenant guard, access decision, redaction rule, safe error, and denial proof.
Schema placeholder, seed runner, fixture plan, migration readiness, and no live data.
Audit writer boundary, release runbook, evidence artifacts, and retention thinking.
First proof commands, smoke placeholder, artifact names, and release-gate summary.

firstPrTemplateChecks.label: Linked issue
firstPrTemplateChecks.check: PR body references PD-BE-001 or the relevant generated backend issue.

firstPrTemplateChecks.label: Scope
firstPrTemplateChecks.check: Files changed match issue scope and starter inventory.

firstPrTemplateChecks.label: Proof
firstPrTemplateChecks.check: Install, lint, typecheck, route envelope, auth tenant, redaction, audit, and release gate outputs are addressed.

firstPrTemplateChecks.label: Release notes
firstPrTemplateChecks.check: Affected rooms and rollback plan are filled, even for initial shell.

firstPrTemplateChecks.label: Reviewer path
firstPrTemplateChecks.check: CODEOWNERS and role signoffs match sensitive file groups.

firstPrTemplateChecks.label: Taxonomy
firstPrTemplateChecks.check: Labels, milestone, status, and proof tags come from the taxonomy catalog.

firstPrTemplateChecks.label: Branch plan
firstPrTemplateChecks.check: develop opens the first PR to main; main is not direct-pushed.

firstPrTemplateChecks.label: Protection note
firstPrTemplateChecks.check: Branch protection is scheduled after first workflow check names are visible.

handoff: v123 turns the backend planning stack into a first-commit QA gate.

The first private backend PR should prove discipline before feature depth: file inventory, no secrets, issue trace, taxonomy, proof commands, release note, rollback note, and branch protection timing.
This checklist intentionally allows some proof commands to begin as placeholders, but only if the PR says that clearly and names the artifact expected later.
v124 can convert setup, issue import, first PR evidence, and owner signoffs into a private repo opening-day runbook.
